feeds.title: Sixty and Me
feeds.description: Sixty and Me is a magazine about life after 60. Our topics range from makeup to nutrition advice for older women.

feeds.title: Prime Women
feeds.description: Prime Women is a lifestyle guide for living well not just living long. We provide a fresh perspective through articles written by prime women for prime women on fashion, travel, fitness, beauty, finances, and entertainment. Follow to keep up with articles on nutrition from Prime Women.

feeds.title: Megan Ware's Nutrition and Diet Blog
feeds.description: Whether you are working 80 hours a week and can't seem to find the time to eat right or you are a stay at home mom who can't figure out how to keep healthy food on the table that your family will actually eat, Megan Ware helps you find a plan to get you on the right track and on the road to a healthy, happy, balanced lifestyle.

feeds.title: Lutz Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: Lutz Nutrition is blog by Raina Dawn who is a holistic nutritionist and coach to women who want to eat clean, organic food. Subscribe us to get nutritious recipes, motivation tips and more.

feeds.title: Marisa Moore
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Marisa, a registered dietitian nutritionist living in Atlanta, GA. I use this blog to share (mostly) vegetarian recipes, credible nutrition information and a peek into my Southern roots and travels!

feeds.title: Whitney E. RD Blog
feeds.description: Whitney English is a Registered Nutritionist Dietician sharing evidence-based nutrition information and healthy plant-based recipes.

feeds.title: Fit Bottomed Girls
feeds.description: We Fit Bottomed Girls are on a mission to show the people of this world that being healthy doesn't have to be boring. Follow to keep up with amazing healthy recipes.

feeds.title: Yummy Inspirations
feeds.description: Yummy Inspirations is a diet recipe blog by Jolene who is passionate about the ketogenic lifestyle. Follow to keep up with low carb high fat keto diet recipes.

feeds.title: Prevention RD
feeds.description: Prevention RD is a blog by Nicole who believes health is about much more than weight or inches, its about happiness and balance. Subscribe us to get a practical, straight-forward, and maintainable approach to a healthy lifestyle.

feeds.title: Ann Louise
feeds.description: Ann Louise Gittleman is a top nutritionist who specializes in weight loss, cleansing diets & natural hormone replacement therapy.

feeds.title: Dietitian Debbie
feeds.description: Debbie is a Registered Dietitian, and writer behind this blog where you'll find healthy, seasonal, vegetarian recipes! She believes that healthy eating and good nutrition shouldn't be complicated so let her make it a little easier for you. Her ultimate goal is to inspire you to eat more plants through drool-worthy recipes that are anything but bland.

feeds.title: Sharon Palmer Blog
feeds.description: Sharon is a registered dietitian nutritionist (RDN) with more than 20 years of experience in the field of plant-based nutrition and sustainability. Join her in this adventure! Explore delicious plant-based recipes, sustainable living tips, and healthy nutrition facts.

feeds.title: Powercakes
feeds.description: Kasey's blog is her way of sharing her 'mission to help empower the youth & help women love their bodies while finding inspiration through fitness and food.'

feeds.title: Nutrition By Carrie Blog
feeds.description: Nutrition By Carrie offers a range of nutrition-related services. Follow to achieve optimal health and mind-body wellness, one bite at a time.

feeds.title: Desiree Nielsen RD Blog
feeds.description: Desiree Nielsen is a registered dietitian whose blog focuses on digestive health, plant-centred diets and anti-inflammatory nutrition.

feeds.title: Kelly Jones Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: Covers articles on nutrition, travel and family, breakfast recipes, main dishes, side dishes and snacks. Kelly is an registered dietitian, board certified in sports nutrition, helping fuel fitness and busy lifestyles with delicious recipes and sustainable tips. As a media spokesperson, consultant and mom, she is here to help you build lasting habits without stress or restriction.

feeds.title: Shahzadi Devje Blog
feeds.description: Shahzadi Devje is a South Asian registered dietitian, mom of three, and healthy living aficionado. Subscribe to know more about her passion for nutrition and wellness through recipes and healthy living tips.

feeds.title: Osinga Nutrition
feeds.description: Osinga Nutrition is a blog by Nicole Osinga who is a registered dietitian. Subscribe us to achieve your healthiest self by getting fresh, practical and scientific nutrition guidance.

feeds.title: Paleo for Women Blog
feeds.description: Paleo for Women is a blog by writer-nutritionist Stefani Ruper. This blog focuses on the potential for natural nutrition and human evolution to mitigate the vast array of women's health issues.

feeds.title: MasalaBody Blog
feeds.description: MasalaBody is a blog by Nagina Abdullah. She helps ambitious, busy women lose weight and have more energy. Subscribe us to get delicious food recipes, weight loss tips and more.

feeds.title: Beaupre Coaching Blog
feeds.description: Beaupre Coaching helps women who are over 50 or 60 lose weight with lasting results. It teaches you about the properties of food and how they affect your appetite, your desire, your mood and your brain.

feeds.title: A Black Girl's Guide To Weight Loss
feeds.description: A Black Girl's Guide To Weight Loss is Erika Nicole Kendall's blog, detailing her journey towards weight loss and better health, including becoming a certified personal trainer and nutritionist. Her mission is to create a place where women can come together and learn about themselves and their health together and become healthy and happy through support, accountability, and positivity.

feeds.title: Strong Fitness Magazine
feeds.description: Strong Fitness Magazine is a source of cutting-edge fitness and health information for the modern woman who lives to be fit. Find quick health and fitness food recipes, nutrition tips, and healthy recipes.

feeds.title: Woman Magazine
feeds.description: The smartest, most stylish weekly for 40-plus women with fashion and beauty to celebrity and food. Follow to keep up with diet tips and recipes.

feeds.title: Carrots 'N' Cake
feeds.description: Carrots 'N' Cake is a healthy living collective that serves to help everyday people achieve more balance via fitness, nutrition, and general best practices to improve one's holistic personal wellness.

feeds.title: Love & Zest Blog
feeds.description: Love and Zest is a food blog written by Kristina LaRue, who shares recipes, life, and nutrition. She also offers nutrition consulting, menu planning, nutrient analysis, and cooking demonstrations that serves to empower individuals to find their healthy balance with fitness and food.

feeds.title: Gut and Psychology Syndrome Diet Journey
feeds.description: Gut and Psychology Syndrome(GAPS) Diet Journey is a blog by Starlene Stewart. Follow to become healthy by eating the GAPS diet.

feeds.title: Raw Food Meal Planner

feeds.title: The Domestic Dietitian

feeds.title: Teaspoon of Spice
feeds.description: Cooking tips, recipes, healthy kitchen hacks, and nutrition adventures. Teaspoon of Spice by two food loving dietitians and moms Deanna and Serena teach people how to cook healthfully and deliciously!
